dedupe_keys.name: birthing facilities in north carolina 1990 to 2019 geocoded master list of hospitals and birth locations restricted

description: This record describes a master list of the hospitals and other facilities where births took place in North Carolina between 1990 and 2019. It was created by the Children's Environmental Health Initiative (CEHI), now at the University of Illinois Chicago, and catalogued on the university's INDIGO repository in September 2026. North Carolina birth records name the county and place of birth, such as a hospital, birthing centre or home, but not the facility address, so CEHI compiled a list of facilities across the thirty years and added addresses and geocodes; a technical report attached to the record explains the method. The source is the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services, Vital Statistics. Only the metadata and report are public: the data are available on request to researchers who work with CEHI under an ethics approval and data use agreement, and the record is marked as in copyright. Coverage is statewide. Caveats: access takes an application and agreement, and facility openings and closures must be read from the list. Simulation uses: historical locations of maternity services for access and closure impact analysis in North Carolina. Related records: the IDEAMAPS emergency obstetric care access data (data-ideamaps-emergency-obstetric-care-access-deprivation) and the CMS hospitals catalogue (data-cms-provider-data-hospitals) are related facility data.
